notes:
Home: a new On leave card shows who is away today, whether it is a full or half day,
and how long their leave runs. Use the arrows or tap the date to see any other day,
for example who will be out next week.

Expense Claims and Travel have been removed. Record what you spend in My Cashbook.

When HR changes an employee's details, the change now saves straight away. The CEO and
MD are notified, and tapping the notification opens that employee's record.

People who have left the company no longer appear in pickers, team lists and search.
